description: Adaptive Surface 0.12.3 isolates adaptive block packets from native cube-space transitions, leaving original source rules as data for the matching-slope overlay system.
changes: Remove TransitionTexture/TransitionToGroups/TransitionToTag and isolate Group in P/Q world packs, legacy root/state JSON and defensive startup shallow copies.
Keep source catalogue/native block rules intact. Reproduce actual Soil_Grass versus Zytale_Soil_Grass_Fir boundary, including asymmetric Grass-group rules and world orientations.
Cover native packet isolation after all startup bindings; generator correction prevents old metadata returning.
advantages: Eliminates two independent transition mechanisms on the same adaptive models
Preserves every image/model and saved ID; no additional atlas cost
No runtime reload or inventory helpers
disadvantages: Client visual acceptance remains pending; no actual framebuffer instrumentation

All loaded adaptive client packets isolated; native source rules preserved; 25 textures and 1050 render helpers unchanged
1765 packaged resources unchanged; core JSON only transition metadata; attachment/placement/geometry/edge/topology classes byte-identical
Migrated active pack: same 201 entries, 89 item JSON changes only transition metadata, every image identical
Installed d5756f8fb656b100deb1d9fac47cbd560572b5a5c583d4c0898b3b0b3a13ed50 with old JAR backup; no save writes during install
